title: Spellforge
description: A painting shows two figures from behind, one blue and one red-orange, standing back to back inside a metal cauldron with their arms raised and hands touching overhead to form an arch. The blue figure is surrounded by green energy and the red by fiery red energy, with swirling colorful patterns, handprints, and floating painted notes around them against a dark starry background.
prompt: A painting viewed from behind shows two human figures standing back to back inside a large metal cauldron. The left figure is blue with green glowing energy covering its body and the right figure is red-orange with fiery red energy. Their arms are raised high with hands touching above their heads. Swirling colorful patterns and handprints circle the base of the cauldron. Painted notes and papers float all around them against a dark purple starry sky background.
